card.name: Words meaning 'regardless of' or 'any'
card.fires_on: Words that open a catch-all or 'no matter what' condition right after a dose or condition, such as regardless, whether, any, no matter, all. Mostly in dosing text.

modes.label: Regardless of
modes.description: 'Regardless' or 'whether' right after a dose, saying the limit holds in every case.
modes.example: the maximum recommended daily oral dose of meloxicam is 15 mg<< regardless>> of formulation.

modes.label: Any or all in dose tables
modes.description: Words like Any, All or Less starting a table cell about weight or dose groups.
modes.example: Patients from 2 Weeks to less than 1 Year of Age<< Any>> weight 3 mg/kg twice daily

modes.label: No matter in general text
modes.description: 'No matter' or 'any' in web text, meaning it does not depend on a condition.
